title: Monthly Order Volume
scenario: Count the number of orders made in each month. Return the result as 'month' and 'order_count'.
tableSchema: delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE)
hint: Format order_date to 'YYYY-MM' and group by it.
correctQuery: SELECT TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(delivery_id) AS order_count FROM delivery GROUP BY month;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE delivery (delivery_id INT, customer_id INT, order_date DATE, customer_pref_delivery_date DATE); INSERT INTO delivery VALUES (1, 1, '2019-08-01', '2019-08-02');
